```{r function-plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline}
#' Plot TVC Album Cover Timeline
#'
#' Plot a fancy timeline of album covers.
#' @param songs a tibble of songs
#' @param search_discogs4Final results from Discogs research, with extra columns Artist, Album Name and Album Year
#' @param year_range a numeric vector of length 2 corresponding to the range for the timeline.
#'
#' @return \code{plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline} returns a tibble of album without proper album covers
#' @export
#' @importFrom attempt stop_if_any
#' @importFrom dplyr slice_head arrange group_by summarise filter distinct inner_join rename select join_by between desc ungroup mutate left_join bind_rows case_when n if_else anti_join
#' @importFrom glue glue
#' @importFrom jpeg readJPEG
#' @importFrom purrr map possibly simplify_all transpose map2 walk2
#' @importFrom tibble as_tibble
#' @importFrom tidyr unnest
#'
#' @examples
plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline <- function(songs, search_discogs4Final, year_range = c(1974, 2003)) {
  tvc_albums <- songs |> 
    dplyr::filter(ISRC != "USAR49914012") |> #  Artist == "Glenn Medeiros"
    dplyr::rename(Album_Name = item.album.name) |> 
    dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::select(triads, - c(Song, Artist)),
                      by = dplyr::join_by(triad, ISRC), 
                      relationship = "many-to-many") |> 
    dplyr::filter(triad == "1 7") |> 
    dplyr::filter(Affirmation != "Discutable" |is.na(Affirmation)) |> 
    ## Keep first artist
    dplyr::distinct(ISRC, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::between(Album_Year, year_range[1L], year_range[2L])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(#main_release_id = list(unique(main_release_id)),
      Nb_Song_TVC = length(unique(ISRC)) + as.integer(any(Affirmation %in% c("Glorieuse", "Matraquée"))),
      .groups = "drop") |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Album_Year) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Nb_Song_TVC)) |> 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 8)
  
  destpath <- "./inst/extdata/album_covers"
  if(!dir.exists(destpath)) {dir.create(destpath)}
  trashpath <- "./inst/extdata/album_covers_trash"
  if(!dir.exists(trashpath)) {dir.create(trashpath)}
  
  dowloaded_files <- list.files(path = destpath)
  trash_files <- list.files(path = trashpath)
  
  tvc_covers0 <- search_discogs4Final |> 
    # dplyr::filter(Artist == "Glenn Medeiros") |>
    # dplyr::filter(Album_Name == "Harmonium") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tvc_albums, by = dplyr::join_by(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name)) |> 
    dplyr::select(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name, master_release, main_release, main_release_id) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      images_master = purrr::map(
        .x = master_release,
        .f = purrr::possibly( ~ {
          .x[["images"]] |> 
            purrr::simplify_all() |>  
            purrr::transpose() |>
            purrr::simplify_all() |>  
            tibble::as_tibble()
        },
        otherwise = NULL)
      ),
      images = purrr::map(
        .x = main_release,
        .f = ~ {
          .x[["images"]] |> 
            purrr::simplify_all() |>  
            purrr::transpose() |>
            purrr::simplify_all() |>  
            tibble::as_tibble()
        }),
      images = purrr::map2(.x = images_master, .y = images, .f = dplyr::bind_rows)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::select(-c(main_release, master_release, images_master)) |> 
    tidyr::unnest(images) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name, main_release_id) |> 
    dplyr::filter(type == "primary" | all(type == "secondary")) |> 
    dplyr::ungroup() |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      basename = paste0(Album_Year, "-", gsub(" ", "_", Artist), "-", basename(uri)),
      destfile = file.path(destpath, basename)
    ) |> 
    dplyr::filter(!basename %in% trash_files) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(type == "primary"), abs(width - height) / width, dplyr::desc(width)) |> 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) |> 
    ## y axis
    dplyr::left_join(tvc_albums,
                     by = dplyr::join_by(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name)) |> 
    ## Big covers two-year
    dplyr::mutate(Biennal = floor(c(Album_Year) *0.5) * 2) |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Biennal) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Nb_Song_TVC)) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(is_Main_Biennal = basename == head(basename, 1L)) |> 
    ## Positions
    dplyr::group_by(Album_Year, is_Main_Biennal) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(Album_Year, is_Main_Biennal, dplyr::desc(Nb_Song_TVC)) |> 
    # dplyr::mutate(y = ceiling((seq_len(dplyr::n()) - 1L) * 0.5) * (as.integer(seq_len(dplyr::n())%%2 == 0) * 2 - 1L)) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = dplyr::case_when(
        is_Main_Biennal ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ (ceiling((seq_len(dplyr::n())) * 0.5) + .5) * (as.integer(seq_len(dplyr::n())%%2 == 0) * 2 - 1L)
      ),
      size = dplyr::case_when(
        is_Main_Biennal ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 1
      ),
      x = dplyr::case_when(
        is_Main_Biennal ~ Biennal + .5,
        TRUE ~ Album_Year
      )
    ) |> 
    ## Adjust Biennal
    dplyr::group_by(Biennal) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      y2 = if(weighted.mean(y * (Album_Year == min(Album_Year)), w = size^2) == weighted.mean(y * (Album_Year == max(Album_Year)), w = size^2)) {
        y - weighted.mean(y, w = size^2)
      } else {
        y
      },
      diffybiennal = y2 -y,
      y = y2
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(-y2) |> 
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  tvc_covers <- tvc_covers0 |> 
    dplyr::group_by(Album_Year) |> 
    # dplyr::filter(!(weighted.mean(y, w = size) != 0 & abs(y - diffybiennal) == max(abs(y - diffybiennal)))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = dplyr::if_else(
        weighted.mean(y, w = size) != 0 & abs(y - diffybiennal) == max(abs(y - diffybiennal)),
        diffybiennal + (y - diffybiennal) * sample(c(-1, 1), size = dplyr::n(), replace = TRUE),
        y
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(-diffybiennal) |> 
    dplyr::ungroup() |> 
    ## Adjust Biennal #2
    dplyr::group_by(Biennal) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      y = if(weighted.mean(y * (Album_Year == min(Album_Year)), w = size^2) == weighted.mean(y * (Album_Year == max(Album_Year)), w = size^2)) {
        y - weighted.mean(y, w = size^2)
      } else {
        y
      },
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  # tvc_covers
  attempt::stop_if_any(duplicated(tvc_covers[["basename"]]))
  # tvc_covers |> dplyr::group_by(basename) |> dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1)
  # plot(tvc_covers$width, tvc_covers$height)
  # tvc_covers |> 
  #   dplyr::filter(!basename %in% dowloaded_files)
  
  tvc_covers |> 
    dplyr::filter(!basename %in% dowloaded_files) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(
      download = purrr::walk2(
        .x = uri, #tvc_covers[["uri"]],
        .y = destfile, #tvc_covers[["destfile"]],
        .f = ~ download.file(url = .x, destfile = .y, mode = "wb")
      )
    )
  
  ## Missing Album Cover
  tvc_songs_search <- dplyr::anti_join(tvc_albums, tvc_covers0,
                                       by = dplyr::join_by(Album_Year, Album_Name)) |> 
    dplyr::select(-Nb_Song_TVC) |>
    ## add song title
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::distinct(songs, Artist, Album_Year, Song),
                     dplyr::join_by(Artist, Album_Year)) |> 
    dplyr::distinct(Artist, Album_Year, Album_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  dpi <- 1200
  
  png(glue::glue("../{format(Sys.Date(), format = '%Y%m%d')}-TVC-album-cover-timeline-{year_range[1L]}-{year_range[2L]}.png"),
      width = dpi * (ceiling(year_range[2L]/2)*2 - year_range[1L])/(10 + 1.2), height = dpi)
  plot(x = c(year_range[1L], ceiling(year_range[2L]/2)*2), y = c(-5, 5), ty="n", xlab = "", ylab = "", frame.plot = FALSE, yaxt = "n")
  
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(tvc_covers))) {
    # img <- png::readPNG(source = z)
    img <- jpeg::readJPEG(source = tvc_covers[["destfile"]][i])
    # grid::grid.raster(image = img, x = 1 , y = 2, width = .9)
    rasterImage(
      img,
      xleft = tvc_covers[["x"]][i] - .5 * tvc_covers[["size"]][i],
      ybottom = tvc_covers[["y"]][i] - .5 * tvc_covers[["size"]][i],
      xright = tvc_covers[["x"]][i] + .5 * tvc_covers[["size"]][i],
      ytop = tvc_covers[["y"]][i] + .5 * tvc_covers[["size"]][i]
    )
  }
  dev.off()
  return(tvc_songs_search)
}
```

```{r examples-plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline}
plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline(songs, search_discogs4Final, year_range = c(1974, 2003))

tvc_songs_search <- plot_tvc_album_cover_timeline(songs, search_discogs4Final, year_range = c(1964, 2025))
```
